name: Elliott Alumni Center
use: UNH Alumni Association and advancement/foundation offices; events
architect: Banwell, White & Arnold, Inc.; built by U.S. Construction Co. of Nashua
style: 1970s modern (brick-and-shingle tower and low wings in 1970s photo)

facts.text: Built with funds from alumni and friends, and named for John S. Elliott, a 1915 agriculture graduate, trustee and donor.
The Alumni Association lists the Elliott Alumni Center, 9 Edgewood Road, as its address.

more.label: UNH Library Archives: administrative and campus life buildings

arch_list.title: UNH Buildings (list with construction dates and uses)

verdict: 1976 alumni building on Edgewood Road with a brick-and-shingle entrance tower; unremarkable and little documented.
notes: The archives spell it both 'Elliott' and 'Elliot'. No renovation history found. No licensed photo found (Commons and Flickr CC searched); ref-01 is a 1970s archives photo of the entrance tower with flags. No reviews.
judgeNotes: Only a 1970s archives photo; no condition or review evidence.
